purpose: Operational human resilience layer connecting needs, resources, official services, community capacity and verified action paths.
principles: Evidence, timestamp and uncertainty are first-class
Use canonical IMA connectors; never create parallel systems
currentImplementation: timezone fallback when country is absent
official-source routing with explicit unknown-source state
safety: Emergency routing must never claim live availability unless a live source is verified.

country_precedence: Google-account country only when explicitly exposed and authorized
optional location only when needed and permission is granted
automationPolicy.privacy: Do not request precise location when locale/timezone are sufficient. Never expose coordinates to the UI or store them in the resilience plan.
automationPolicy.eligibility: Country detection never implies eligibility. IMA must ask for or verify the legal/benefit facts required by the relevant authority.
automationPolicy.source_rule: Only configured or verified official sources may be presented as official. Unknown country/source must be labeled unknown rather than guessed.

socialProtection.coverage: Global country-aware routing with shared benefit domains and localized labels.
socialProtection.fallback: Use country/language detection for every country even when a verified official portal has not yet been configured; never fabricate a government URL.
